description: Get a quarter's tax figures as the household's Taxes page shows them: `items` is the checklist of what to pay or file, to whom and by when (an item of kind `rec` has no hard deadline this quarter but may still be owed); `federal` is the optional estimated payment (Form 1040-ES) for the IRS installment in `installment_period`, which settles on Schedule H with Form 1040; `state_destinations` is each state agency with its due date and what is owed; `state_lines` is wages and each state and local line. Amounts are dollars. A null amount means NannyKeeper will not stand behind a figure yet: say so and give the reason (`waiting_on`, `fica`, `rate_needed`), and never report it as $0 or as nothing owed. NannyKeeper does not file or pay for the household. For a household other than the key's own, pass its employer_id.

employer_id.description: Optional. Leave it out to use the household your API key belongs to. Pass it only when one account manages several households; list_employees returns it.

name: get_quarter_taxes
